author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
Microsoft quietly added an Xbox Mode to Windows 11 that strips out background processes, boots straight into Steam Big Picture or the Xbox interface, and saves nearly a gig of RAM. No dedicated console required — this turns any Windows PC into a legit home theater gaming machine. Here's how to set it up today using KB5083631, the Xbox Fullscreen Experience Tool, and OmniConsole 2.1.

🔗 Xbox Fullscreen Experience Tool: https://github.com/8bit2qubit/XboxFullscreenExperienceTool
🔗 Microsoft Update Catalog (KB5083631): https://catalog.update.microsoft.com/Search.aspx?q=KB5083631
